wholePhysicalScope: Oak Bay Archives fixes the 144 ft 2 in by 322 ft 2 in rink dimensions and the historic address east of Epworth Street. The modern road survey constrains placement and orientation. Setbacks are estimates.
lodDetails: Four authored levels preserve the full historic rink, barrel roof, corner towers and facade. Near views add storefront and sash detail, historic lettering and curved roof seams.
limitations: The arena is displayed as a historical structure from its public opening on December 25, 1911 through November 10, 1929. The appearance represents the 1925 Stanley Cup game, using an opening-era photograph.
The archive records the historical address and building dimensions. The absolute setback from the modern intersection and the elevation of the rink floor are estimates.

The source photograph is monochrome. Timber and roof colors, the far end wall, height, side window rhythm, and roof details are reconstructed from appearance, proportions, or period construction descriptions.
The exterior includes the rink hall. The separate engine house, rink interior, street furniture and later neighborhood buildings are outside the model scope.
